rules: A catalog record is not executable merely because it has a form.
A native backend route must name a concrete server route or an explicit remote-required reason.
Local processing errors never trigger an implicit upload.
Every remote file operation must disclose the files leaving the device and require an explicit user action.
A new local claim requires a platform handler and a platform test fixture before it is published.
